summary: Replace the ACME account of a CA

requestBody.description: The CA whose account is replaced, and the values of the new account

server.description: The CA's ACME directory URL; its account must be registered

email.description: Contact email of the new account, default the current one, empty for none

eab_kid.description: EAB key ID of the new account, for a CA that needs one

eab_hmac_key.description: EAB HMAC key of the new account, for a CA that needs one

deactivate_old.description: For a compromised key only: deactivates the old account at the CA, which can then no longer revoke the certificates it issued

200.description: The ACME settings after the replacement, with replaced telling what happened to the old account

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot be used for this request`.

description:
Registers a new account at the same CA and moves the CA's certificates to it: the renewal configurations name the new account and the old account stays on disk, unused. With deactivate_old the old account is also deactivated at the CA, which cannot be undone and which only suits a compromised key. When the CA refuses the new account nothing changes and the answer is 400. When only the deactivation fails the switch stays done and replaced.old_account is deactivation-failed. Only a registered account can be replaced.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused). Administrators only
